about: Compressed-size budget per image and arch, in MB (1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes, the sum of the manifest's layer sizes). images.yml checks every build against it (scripts/ci/image_report.py budget). In mode "warn" an over-budget build prints a warning; in mode "fail" it fails. PRD-262 US-004 sets each budget to the five-run median plus 2% and switches the mode to "fail". Raise a budget only in the pull request that needs it, and say why in its reason. An entry may also hold on_disk_max_mb, a bar on the size docker image inspect reports for the image pulled from the job's registry, in the same unit and mode: media-render, which is never published, is barred on disk (PRD-262 §8, US-054).
